notes.title: 【Version 1.0.4】Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear passengers,

We have been working hard to address the pressing issues that you have brought to our attention and to improve your gaming experience. Below are the details of this update: 

[list]
[*] Modified the text for the save function: Changed "Create New Save" to "Start New Game" to prevent players from confusing this as a save function and accidentally overwriting their progress.
[*] Added the "Skip Prologue Tutorial" feature: After completing the prologue tutorial once, you can now use the "Skip Prologue Tutorial" feature when starting the prologue with other save files.
[*] Streamlined the prologue scenes, eliminating the need to reexperience certain repetitive plot points.
[*] Introduced guidance to enhance the puzzle-solving experience for the "Auction Quest."
[*] Adjusted level guidance to enhance the puzzle-solving experience for the "Enter the Communication Room Quest."
[*] Trimmed certain scenes in the Javert storyline - Factory level.
[*] Corrected typos in certain dialogue texts.
[/list]
 
If you have any suggestions or feedback about the game, please feel free to connect with us through the social media buttons on the in-game homepage. By clicking on them, you can join the respective community and interact with us. 
We would like to extend our heartfelt appreciation to all the players who offered their valuable feedback. Here's to you! 🍻

notes.title: A Guidebook of Babel Closed Beta Test!
notes.content:
Hello, passengers. We're ecstatic to announce that the Closed Beta Test for A Guidebook of Babel will take place from 5 November to 11 November. Please see the details below:

[b]About our Game:[/b]
Rewrite the past and change the future! A Guidebook of Babel is a plot-driven adventure game with the unique "Butterfly Effect" mechanic.

Experience a fantastical afterlife journey, ride through monsoons in the belly of a puffer fish, and board a giant ship called Babel where the wishes and regrets of our travelers are intertwined.

[b]Purpose of the Closed Beta Test:[/b]
We want to know your play experience, identify any potential issues, and address them to make our game even better.
A feedback survey will be sent out to everyone who participates in the closed beta test, and the results will be shared directly with the development team. Depending on your feedback, we may invite you to an in-depth 1-on-1 follow-up interview.

[b]Participation Requirements:[/b]
- Must be at least 18 years old.
- Will need to sign an NDA
- Must test the game thoroughly and provide feedback via the survey

[b]Application Period and Selection Announcement:[/b]
Complete this [url=https://forms.gle/3vZteecUoUjwFM2z7]questionnaire[/url] by November 2 to submit your application. We will select the participants according to the information you fill in, and the results will be announced on November 4.

[b]Test time:[/b]
November 5-November 11

[b]Bonus:[/b]
- Everyone selected for the closed beta test will be added to the game's "Thank You" list
- Participants will be gifted with the official version of the game + OST + Artbook

notes.title: Babel Devblog - March/April
notes.content:
[i]Beep beep...[/i]

Hey there! This is our first dev log since...probably a year ago! 

Nice to meet you all, we're [b]Gardener and Rick[/b], the team behind A Guidebook of Babel...we've picked up the development speed recently and also have kickstarted our community channels. It's a pleasure to finally also have a [b]new store page[/b], so check us out.

We've all boarded now - so find us on [url=https://discord.gg/2yeTS9AB4B]Discord[/url]

[i]Our social channels have also recently opened:[/i]
[url=https://www.twitter.com/GoBabelgame]Twitter[/url] (#GoBabelgame) | [url=https://www.instagram.com/gobabelgame/ ]Instagram [/url]|[url=https://www.facebook.com/GoBabelgame ] Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/guidebookofbabel/]Reddit[/url]

Now...unto more relevant things about development progress...
First, if you haven't checked out our store page yet, the Babel is a cruise ship that looks somewhat like this ([i]see that statue in the center there?[/i])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170071/b0b28afbeccdc8104d387970d0744ae05028fd9c.png[/img]

Sorry for derailing again...so we have completed the development of the opening stage of the game. We have to brag [i]high pitched voice[/i] that this is no usual opening, but we believe a fairly creative one. The first six stages (you can see five stages in the image below) will comprise of pieces webbed together by butterfly effect, in which we'll use to capture new passengers boarding the Babel! [i]evil laughter [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39170071/a7c1b20ea4f4dc2254ffcb45f83c2c89094f0429.png[/img]

We'll be sure to soon release a demo so you know exactly what we're talking about!

[b][i]Some other updates include[/i][/b]:
[list]
[*] - Two new additions to our team! (Storywriting & programming)
[*] - Working on new stages involving the character of Sylvia and swim team captain Javert
[*] - Localization updates and optimization
[*] - Previous stage expansion and completions
[/list]
Later this week, we're preparing to give you a sneak peek of [i][b]one wild night on the deck[/b][/i]. Stay tuned for that!

That's all for now folks!

[i]This is Gardener, over and out.[/i]
[i]Beep---[/i]
